definitions.explanation: The final days of a month, typically the last few days.

examples.japanese: {月末|げつまつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit it by the end of the month.

examples.japanese: {月末|げつまつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: The end of the month is always busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月末|げつまつ}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Salary is paid at the end of the month.

notes:
{月末|げつまつ} specifically refers to the end of the month.

Related time expressions:
- ⟦{月初|げっしょ}→月初：18530_gessho⟧ (beginning of the month)
- ⟦{月半|つきなか}ば→月半ば：27355_tsukinakaba⟧ (middle of the month)
- {月末|げつまつ} (end of the month)

Common collocations:
- {月末|げつまつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (by the end of the month)
- {月末|げつまつ}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧ (end-of-month payment)
- {月末|げつまつ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (end-of-month processing)
- {月末|げつまつ}⟦{締|し}め→締め：16134_shime⟧ (closing at month-end)

Business context:
- Many deadlines and payments are set at {月末|げつまつ}
